definition: farm animals kept for milk and meat
description: On a tropical beach at dusk with palm trees and a thatched beach bar with lights, a group of cows of different colours wanders along the sand and the water's edge. A pale cow and a small dark calf walk side by side through the foaming waves towards the camera. A spotted cow lies on a striped beach towel under a pink umbrella, and other cows stand by sun loungers and a surfboard on the sand. Wooden fishing boats rest further along the beach.

to rest on a striped towel
